name: repo-sync
description: Fast-forwards the git repos you list at session start, and tells Claude when an instructions file such as AGENTS.md changed under it

repos.title: Repos to pull
repos.description: Folders to pull with git pull --ff-only when a session starts, separated by commas. ~ means your home folder. Leave empty to do nothing.

watch.title: Files that mean re-read
watch.description: File names, separated by commas. When a pull changes one of them, Claude is told to re-read it, since the copy it loaded at startup may be stale.

timeoutSeconds.title: Pull timeout (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: How long a pull may take before it is given up. The first prompt waits at most this long for the result. Default 20; enter 0 to reset to it.
